import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the necessary GSL functions and types
gsl_rng_alloc = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc
gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

gsl_rng_set = gsl.gsl_rng_set
gsl_rng_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_ulong]
gsl_rng_set.restype = None

gsl_rng_free = gsl.gsl_rng_free
gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl_rng_free.restype = None

# Correct the function name to gsl_rng_uniform which is available in GSL
gsl_rng_uniform = gsl.gsl_rng_uniform
gsl_rng_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
gsl_rng_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_double

gsl_rng_ranlxd1 = ctypes.cast(ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_ranlxd1"), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p))

def generate_random_double(seed):
    # Allocate the random number generator
    rng = gsl_rng_alloc(gsl_rng_ranlxd1)
    if not rng:
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to allocate RNG")

    try:
        # Set the seed
        gsl_rng_set(rng, seed)

        # Generate a random double
        random_value = gsl_rng_uniform(rng)
        return random_value
    finally:
        # Free the RNG
        gsl_rng_free(rng)

def assert_test():
    # Test with a specific seed
    seed = 12345
    random_value = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert isinstance(random_value, float), "Output should be a float"

    # Test with another seed
    seed = 67890
    random_value = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert isinstance(random_value, float), "Output should be a float"

    # Test with edge case seed
    seed = 0
    random_value = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert isinstance(random_value, float), "Output should be a float"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
